Grit wo chup chup ki lagan hai jo shak ki garaj se bhi zyada tikti hai.
Khamoshi—God ki language hai.
Grit matlab chhorna nahi.
Himmat mein jaadoo aur taqat hai.
Chuppi gyaan ki jad hai.
Grit hai lagatar chalna choose karna.
Saat baar giro aur aathvi baar khade ho jaao.
Jo lagta hai na ho sake, wahi karo.
Planned great se better—done small deeds.
Himmat mein genius aur shakti hai.
Grit aazad hai.
Lambe daud ki bajaye, lagataar chhoti chhoti daud hoti hain.
Aap jitne shaant hote jaayenge, utna zyada sun paayenge.
Aantarik shaanti se badi koi taakat nahi hoti.
Aage badhte raho—yeh grit hai.
Grit ichha hai.
Khamoshi ek dhaal hai.
Darr ke bawajood kaam karna hi himmat hai.
Khamosh himmat zordaar ko hara deti hai.
Himmat dar ka ilaaj hai.
Chuppi takat ka srot hai.
